FUNCTION handleStartTrip(request, trip_id):
    // REQ-fleet-temporal-conflict-v1-018; preconditions: JSON and persistence available.
    REQUIRE authenticated user or admin or RETURN 401; REQUIRE application/json or RETURN 415.
    LOAD trip; RETURN 404 if invalid/absent; RETURN 403 if user is not requester; VALIDATE timestamp or RETURN 422/400.
    BEGIN TRANSACTION; lock trip, vehicle, driver, and schedules.
    IF trip not PLANNED, timestamp before plan, conflicts exist, or vehicle not AVAILABLE THEN ROLLBACK; RETURN 409. END IF
    SET trip IN_PROGRESS and vehicle ASSIGNED; COMMIT; RETURN 200.
    // REQ-fleet-temporal-conflict-v1-004, -005, -007, -008; non-idempotent; rollback preserves relations.
